records.text: Aqueous is a water elemental who welcomes visitors to the Hidden Reef and can speak with them mind to mind. Aqueous sees water as the source and sustenance of life, and warns that the pollution afflicting Bloodmyst Isle could spread through the ocean currents. The elemental investigates the corruption’s extent and source, then calls for it to be stopped.
Watery Aspect is an elemental found on Bloodmyst Isle.
A Bristlelimb Shaman is a humanoid of the Bristlelimb encountered on Bloodmyst Isle.
A Bristlelimb Warrior, a humanoid fighter of Bloodmyst Isle who attacks with Strike.
An infected wildkin whose combat response is to inflict Infected Wound, an attack that matches its name.
A contaminated wildkin. Its name marks it apart from the infected and irradiated wildkin found in the same wider region.
An irradiated wildkin encountered alongside infected and contaminated wildkin in the surrounding region.
A Blacksilt forager, identified by a gathering role among the group’s people.
A Blacksilt scout with a field role distinct from the foragers and tidecallers nearby.
A Blacksilt tidecaller who answers combat with a spell, a role distinct from the foragers and scouts nearby.
Blacksilt Shorestrikers are recurring combatants. Their name marks a shore-striking role among the Blacksilt.
A Blacksilt Warrior, a humanoid fighter of Bloodmyst Isle.
Blacksilt Seers are spellcasters who hurl Wrath at foes and, when badly hurt, call on Rejuvenation to heal themselves and a nearby friend.
Wrathscale Shorestalkers are recurring combatants. Their shorestalker name supplies the defining role for this group.
Wrathscale Screamers are a recurring group on Bloodmyst Isle that fight with a spell in combat, not only up close.
Wrathscale Marauders are recurring combatants. Their marauder role identifies them within the Wrathscale group.
A Wrathscale Sorceress of Bloodmyst Isle who hurls Frostbolt at her foes.

A Nazzivus satyr encountered in the Nazzivian area. Vindicator Aalesia describes the Nazzivus as satyrs descended from the first creature to ally with the Burning Legion and fears they may exploit the Exodar's crystals. This creature is among the targets in her offensive against them.

A Nazzivus rogue encountered in the Nazzivian area. Vindicator Aalesia describes the Nazzivus as satyrs descended from the first creature to ally with the Burning Legion and fears they may exploit the Exodar's crystals. This rogue is among the targets in her offensive against them.

A Nazzivus felsworn, one of the satyrs Vindicator Aalesia says descend from the first creature to ally with the Burning Legion; she fears they will use the Exodar's crystals against the draenei. It hurls Shadow Bolt.

An Axxarien shadowstalker found in the area where the Nazzivus leader resides. Vindicator Aalesia calls the satyrs the Burning Legion's hounds and fears they may turn the Exodar's corrupted crystals into weapons. She names this creature among those to eliminate.

An Axxarien trickster found in the area where the Nazzivus leader resides. Vindicator Aalesia calls the satyrs the Burning Legion's hounds and fears they may turn the Exodar's corrupted crystals into weapons.
An Axxarien Hellcaller is one of the satyr threats targeted by the draenei at Blood Watch. Its role here is as a hostile combatant.
A Thistle Lasher is a plant creature encountered in several parts of Azuremyst Isle.
A Mutated Constrictor is a beast found around Azuremyst Isle.
Mutated Tanglers near the Vector Coil have gained some sentience and set concealed traps, according to Vindicator Corin. This Tangler is one of the creatures the draenei ask adventurers to attack.
Blue Flutterers are small creatures found around Azuremyst.

Royal Blue Flutterers are a corrupted flutterer population in Azuremyst. Tracker Lyceon describes the affected flutterers as damaging what they touch; their growing contamination is linked to the crystal shards scattered by the Exodar's crash.
Corrupted Treants are treant creatures affected by corruption in Azuremyst.
Corrupted Stompers are corrupted creatures in Azuremyst.

Fouled Water Spirits inhabit the foul pool north of Vindicator's Rest. Vindicator Corin reports that crystal energy is turning them toward crystal and that they are especially dangerous; he fears the Sunhawks could exploit them as an energy source.

Clopper Wizbang is a gnomish Explorers' League researcher studying Blacksilt murlocs. He hides in a beached turtle shell so his presence won't affect his observations, and treats the loss of his equipment as a chance to learn more. He plans to report his findings in Ironforge and exhibit examples of murloc craft.

Harbinger Mikolaas is responsible for Blood Watch’s defenses and other duties assigned by the Exodar. He gathers crystal samples from across Bloodmyst to compare signs of corruption and report the findings to the Exodar, though he worries research competes with urgent problems at the outpost. Vigilance matters to him on a dangerous island, and the loss of a survey team weighs on him.

Anchorite Paetheus is a Blood Watch first aid trainer whose travels have given him tools, artifacts, and knowledge from many peoples. His scholarly eye helps him decipher Nolkai’s journal, despite its distracting account of Andrew Clementine’s drunken exploits. He draws on Blood Watch’s limited resources to seek cooperation with the Alliance against their enemies.

At Blood Watch, Vindicator Aalesia investigates the Nazzivus satyr’s ties to the Burning Legion. She interprets their monument glyphs as evidence that a creature willingly became a Legion servant, and studies what is learned to plan a response. After identifying felguard armor among the satyrs’ signs of Legion contact, she says she will alert Harbinger Mikolaas.

Morae is Blood Watch’s herbalism trainer and a researcher studying how Exodar crystals affect Bloodmyst’s wildlife. She suspects corrupted treants show the effects and studies Blacksilt murlocs, whose organization she finds intriguing. She is also searching for her husband Galaen, a Cryo-Core technician; learning of his death leaves her grieving but grateful that she finally knows what happened.

Zevrax is the satyr leader based in Axxarien, where he gathers corrupted crystals. The draenei at Blood Watch regard him and his followers as a threat tied to the Burning Legion and seek to stop their use of the crystals as weapons.
Cruelfin, titled Rawgrlgrlgrlgrlgrrgle, made a crude red crystal pendant whose pulsing crystal seems tainted. Morae at Blood Watch takes an interest in it.

Myst Spinners are massive, aggressive spiders in Bloodmyst's western wilds, swollen by crystal contamination. Achelus says they attacked his research team; they are hunted with Myst Leechers and their leader, Zarakh.

Myst Leechers are massive, aggressive spiders found with Myst Spinners in Bloodmyst's western wilds. Achelus says they attacked his research team; they are hunted with Myst Spinners and their leader, Zarakh.
A Nazzivus Summoner, a demon of Bloodmyst Isle.

Bloodmyst Hatchlings are ravagers, an insectoid predator species brought aboard the Exodar from Outland. Some specimens escaped after the crash and survived in the wild; Vorkhan asks that the hatchlings near Kessel's Crossing be killed to protect the islands' natural balance.

Tzerak meets help with open contempt, calling others “fools” and “weaklings” while insisting he needs no assistance. He carries himself as a fiercely self-reliant figure and moves along an aggressive patrol, though his wider loyalties are unclear.
When restored to life with the Symbol of Life, a young Stillpine shaman stares in wonder before declaring, “I run now!” The rescue is immediately followed by flight from the Bristlelimb camp.
A Blood Watch peacekeeper represents the community's public watch and has a protective civic role.
Void Anomalies are creatures associated with rifts opened on Bloodmyst Isle. Vindicator Boros investigates them as possible evidence of blood elf portals to Outland.

Caregiver Topher Loaal is establishing Blood Watch's inn from a salvaged pod and needs furnishings and first aid supplies. He wants a place to care for the wounded and survivors the settlement encounters, and thanks the vindicators for helping prepare it.

Laando is Blood Watch's hippogryph master. For a fee, he arranges travel to the Exodar, describing the flight as a faster and safer way to carry an important message. He also directs travelers to speak with him again to arrange a ride.

Vorkhan is an elekk herder at Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle. He warns that ravagers carried from Outland could upset the island's natural balance, and has recruits cull them before they displace native predators. He also puts a newly arrived recruit to work in the elekk herding effort.

A Veridian Whelp is an agitated spirit of the green dragonflight, bound to the land and unable to reach its final rest in the Emerald Dream. Prince Toreth says recovering the fallen dragons' bones has calmed these spirits, and asks that their remaining ethereal manifestations be destroyed so they can be released.

A Veridian Broodling is an agitated spirit of the green dragonflight, bound to the land and unable to reach its final rest in the Emerald Dream. Prince Toreth says recovering the fallen dragons' bones has calmed these spirits, and asks that their remaining ethereal manifestations be destroyed so they can be released.

Aonar gathers sand pears on Bloodmyst Isle and makes them into pies; he also shares the fruit with the elekks he cares for. The pears are becoming harder to find, so he fears he will soon lack time to gather enough for treats and another pie. In a conditional greeting, he complains that Kessel's elekk-care job turned out to involve a shovel.

The Draenei Cartographer is one of the surveyors Harbinger Mikolaas sent to map Bloodmyst Isle. The survey team was killed at the Ruins of Loreth'Aran, and naga took their survey data; recovering the crystal could preserve the crew's findings.
A Sunhawk Spy is a Sunhawk blood elf in Bladewood, northwest of Blood Watch, where the Hand of Argus wants such blood elves killed. It casts a spell at foes who come into sight.
A Sunhawk Reclaimer is a Sunhawk combatant in Bloodmyst. It prepares Frost Armor while out of combat, giving it a defensive magical role.
A Sunhawk Defender is among the Sunhawk forces occupying camps west of Blood Watch. It fights with a combat spell, and the Hand of Argus targets it while trying to reduce those forces.
A Sunhawk Pyromancer is among the Sunhawk forces occupying the camps west of Blood Watch. It casts a spell at foes who come into sight.
A Sunhawk Saboteur serves among the Sunhawk defenses near the Vector Coil. The Hand of Argus seeks to clear a path for its champion; this combatant uses spells and keeps ranged distance in a fight.
A Sunhawk Agent is one of the Sunhawk defenders near the Vector Coil, where the Hand of Argus wants the path cleared for its champion. A seasoned fighter, it casts a spell in battle.

Tracker Lyceon is a Blood Watch woodsman who looks for practical uses in Bloodmyst Isle’s altered environment. He supplements the settlement’s food with bear meat, develops toxin-bearing vine traps against Sunhawk attacks, and sees culling mutated flutterers as a temporary way to limit the damage they cause. He urges others at Blood Watch to recognize these opportunities.

Kessel, Elekk Lord and disciple of the Hand of Argus, tests prospective recruits and sends them to Exarch Admetius for further training. He entrusts a recruit with warning allied leaders of a planned Sunhawk offensive, and answers a naga attack with a deliberately fearsome retaliation. Kessel teaches that the Hand values honour, while acknowledging that honourable people may fail to act honourably and that violence can sometimes be necessary.

Exarch Admetius leads Blood Watch and the Hand of Argus on Bloodmyst Isle. He draws on draenei history when speaking of Argus and the eredar, and directs recruits toward Vindicator Boros for training. He is also planning against the Sunhawk army, seeking intelligence on its defenses and a way to destroy the Vector Coil. His own words reject torture in favor of covert interrogation.
A humanoid Blade of Argus that kneels when it appears.
Deathclaw is a dangerous marauding bear on Bloodmyst Isle. A wanted notice says the bear killed a survey team near the coast northwest of Blood Watch and warns travelers to avoid the area.

Jessera of Mac’Aree is a mushroom enthusiast. They seek distinct specimens from across Bloodmyst, including Ysera’s Tears from Wyrmscar, and want to return to the mushroom thicket after finding an especially mature cluster. Their memories of Mac’Aree on Argus are vivid and wistful: they recall its mineral-lined walkways and shining rivers, and wonder how long they have been away.
Matis the Cruel, Herald of Sironas, is a hostile figure targeted for capture by Blood Watch. When confronted, he vows he will not be taken alive.
Astur is a stable master who can stable a hunter’s pet or help recover a lost companion. His greetings distinguish between those two services.
Beega is a bowyer who sells goods, including ammunition, and offers repairs.
Stinkhorn Strikers are beasts found in Bloodmyst. Aquatic Stinkhorns can be gathered from them, linking these creatures to the region’s mushroom gathering.

Prince Toreth is a dragon rider of Loreth'Aran, bound with his people to the sundered land. He says the owlkin's theft of dragon bones has unsettled Ysera's brood and that Razormaw, a dead lieutenant of Deathwing, still haunts the island. He seeks the bones' return and the release of bound dragon spirits, and honors help given to his people.

Achelus is Blood Watch's chief expeditionary officer. He says his research team was attacked by unusually large, aggressive spiders near Blood Watch; he escaped, but the team's fate is uncertain. Concerned that others may suffer the same fate, he asks for the spiders and their matriarch to be dealt with, then asks whether anyone survived. He admits few would accept the mission and calls the volunteer brave.

Sironas is a demon who leads the blood elves plotting to enslave O'ros and retake the Exodar. His side poisons the land with the Vector Coil's mutagenic fallout. He scorns challengers as petulant children who are about to meet their gods.

Princess Stillpine is held captive by the Bristlelimb and fears being sacrificed to their gods. She asks a rescuer to provoke and kill High Chief Bristlelimb for the cage key, promising that her father will reward her release. On rescue she expresses gratitude and anticipates her father's delight.

Zarakh is the spider matriarch leading the Myst Spinners and Myst Leechers of Amberweb Pass. Achelus blames crystal contamination for the spiders' great size and aggression after they attacked his research team, and seeks Zarakh's destruction to protect others. Her combat repertoire includes Poison and Web.

Vindicator Boros is a draenei of the Triumvirate of the Hand at Blood Watch. He has worked out how to purify irradiated crystal shards into usable crystals and exchanges them for more shards. He sends adventurers against Sunhawk spies, recognizes Thalassian, and knows someone who can translate it.

Researcher Cornelius survived a spider ambush that left his expedition wrapped in cocoons. After cutting himself free, he escaped but refuses to leave his team behind, and asks for help freeing the researchers before they become food for the brood. When many are rescued, he thanks the rescuer and says the deed will reach Blood Watch and the exarch.
Lord Xiz is a naga leader associated with Wrathscale Lair. Kessel seeks to make Xiz an example after a naga attack on the camp.

High Chief Bristlelimb leads the Bristlelimb furbolgs at their Stillpine enclave on Bloodmyst. The rescue account says he holds the key to Princess Stillpine’s cage and that killing enough furbolgs there can draw him out to seek vengeance. His encounter cry warns intruders to face the wrath of Bristlelimb.

Messenger Hermesius handles mail to and from Azuremyst and is the contact for an urgent delivery from a human admiral whose name he cannot quite recall. He complains that people ignore the mail and that his workload is overwhelming, and grumbles about being pushed around. In one outburst he threatens to unleash a crystalline doomhammer on the town.

Captain Edward Hanes is a dead captain who says he has spent twenty years at the Bloodcursed Reef, where the bloodcurse sank ships. He wants the trapped voyagers' souls put to rest, the bloodcursed naga cleared, and Atoph, the Bloodcursed leader, slain. He can cast a spell that lets others breathe and move underwater.

Bloodcursed Naga are naga associated with Azshara in Hanes’s account of the reef. He calls for them to be removed, and they fight intruders; his quest presents them as one part of the threat to travelers at sea.
Bloodcursed Voyagers are ghosts of people taken by the bloodcurse. Hanes seeks to destroy their cursed shells so their souls can be put to rest.

A captured Sunhawk agent held in a cage, this prisoner says draenei captured them as they left the sun gate, killed the portal controllers, and destroyed the gate. The agent expects the Sun King to be displeased and speaks of the draenei with contempt.

Interrogator Elysia is Blood Watch’s chief interrogator and is fluent in Thalassian. She reads the Sunhawk missive and interprets it as evidence that the blood elves have opened a portal to Outland, which could explain their growing numbers. Though busy, she expects agents to bring her matters of importance.

Vindicator Kuros is the second member of the Triumvirate of the Hand. He took Vindicator Saruan’s place after the search for his mentor, teacher, and master was abandoned; learning of Saruan’s fate leaves him tearful, then angry at Matis. Kuros directs trusted agents and trackers to capture Matis alive and bring him before the Triumvirate.

Vindicator Aesom identifies himself as the third of the Triumvirate of the Hand. At Blood Watch, he directs the campaign against the Sunhawks, ordering strikes on their forces and gate, and investigates pollution in the water supply. He also trains others; his teaching and quest availability depend on context.
Void Critters are associated with void energy released near the sun gate. Local observers report that they grow into void anomalies, but admit that the creatures' nature is poorly understood.

Scout Loryi is a reconnaissance scout whose squad found the Sun Gate and its void-energy danger. She warns that void critters near the portal could grow into void anomalies, and her account points to the wounded Jorli. She condemns the blood elves’ reckless magic.

Scout Jorli is a wounded member of the Sun Gate reconnaissance mission, stranded with Scout Loryi at Vindicator’s Rest. She fears the ravagers that would attack if they abandon their consecrated position, and weighs the danger of evacuation against waiting for a medic. Her words also show the losses among her friends and comrades.

Demolitionist Legoso undertakes the destruction of the Vector Coil and the defeat of Sironas, warning volunteers that the mission may cost their lives and respecting a decision to refuse. Legoso needs protection while fighting through Sunhawk forces and planting explosives near the core's large red crystal, urging companions to stay close and provide cover. At the mission's conclusion, Legoso expresses stunned relief at the defeat of the blood elves and their leader.

Vindicator Corin prepares the defenses around the Vector Coil for Legoso's mission, which Corin regards as suicidal and suitable only for a fearless volunteer. Corin stays near Vindicator's Rest and seeks help clearing Sunhawks and mutated tanglers whose concealed traps threaten reinforcements and attacks. Corin is also alarmed by water spirits apparently turning entirely to crystal and wants them destroyed before the Sunhawks can exploit them for energy.
Archimindy is a beast on Bloodmyst Isle.

Defender Adrielle is a Hand of Argus defender and quest giver at Vindicator’s Rest. Her assigned work sends adventurers against mutated tanglers and fouled water spirits altered by crystal energy, while the defenders hold their post.
Defender Kaegan is identified with the Hand of Argus, the order he serves as a defender. His name and title mark his place among the order’s stationed defenders.
Defender Ursi serves as a Hand of Argus defender. The order’s name and her title identify her as one of its stationed guards.
Defender Kranos is a Hand of Argus defender, identified by his title and affiliation with the order’s stationed guards.

Defender Sorli is a Hand of Argus defender and quest giver at Vindicator’s Rest. The quests assigned to Sorli send adventurers against mutated tanglers and fouled water spirits changed by crystal energy, as the defenders maintain their post.
Defender Auston is a Hand of Argus defender.
Defender Haqi is a Hand of Argus defender.
Defender Kadithuul is a Hand of Argus defender.
Defender Akee is a Hand of Argus defender.
Defender Kajad is a Hand of Argus defender.
Knight-Defender Zunade leads Blood Watch’s defenses and serves the Light unquestioningly. She offers to explain the conflict in Bloodmyst and the defenders’ purpose.
Defender Zaibach is a Hand of Argus defender.
Defender Ashoon is a Hand of Argus defender.
Defender Katroi is a Hand of Argus defender.
Fazu is a tradesman in Blood Watch who sells goods.

Stillpine Ambassador Frasaboo represents High Chief Stillpine in Blood Watch. He speaks of a prophecy and welcomes the visitor as someone foretold. After freeing Princess Stillpine, rescuers are directed to speak with him.

Prospector Nachlan is a veteran of the Explorers' League who has traveled widely across Azeroth. Sent with Captain Odesyus' expedition to watch Clopper Wizbang, he resents being pulled from a promising dig and is bemused by the gnome's wish to prospect and fascination with murlocs. Bloodmyst has still surprised him.
Meriaad is a general goods seller on Bloodmyst Isle.
Little Azimi, who introduces themself as Azimi, makes the walk out to sell the men fresh fruit and water. They also offer food to visitors who are hungry or thirsty.
Fenissa the Assassin is a hostile named assassin found in several parts of Bloodmyst Isle.

The Bloodmyst Isle Flame Warden tends the island's Alliance festival flame and welcomes visitors who come to honor it. The Warden urges the Alliance to honor its fires and speaks of Horde fires with open hostility, encouraging their desecration.

place_records.text: You are in Bloodmyst Isle, Alliance land in Kalimdor. Blood Watch is its main settlement, an Alliance outpost where the Triumvirate of the Hand keeps watch. Wrathscale naga, Blacksilt murlocs, Sunhawk agents and mutated wildlife are the main dangers, found across the coasts, the ruins and the wilds.

You are in Blood Watch, an Alliance outpost on Bloodmyst Isle. Vindicator Aesom of the Triumvirate of the Hand directs the campaign against the Sunhawks, and Morae studies how Exodar crystals are changing the island's wildlife. Laando, the hippogryph master, arranges flights to the Exodar, and the outpost has an inn and a flight master.
You are in Bladewood, an area northwest of Blood Watch where blood elves control the crystals. Sunhawk spies and mutated constrictors are the dangers here.
You are in The Vector Coil, where Sunhawk agents and saboteurs prowl. Matis the Cruel and Fenissa the Assassin are among the dangerous individuals found here.

You are in The Cryo-Core, a crash site on Bloodmyst Isle where the body of Galaen lies in the wreckage. Sunhawk reclaimers and enraged ravagers roam here. Galaen's journal tells of Vindicator Saruan's fate.
You are in The Crimson Reach on Bloodmyst Isle, where Wrathscale naga, screamers, marauders, shorestalkers and sorceresses roam alongside Bloodmyst hatchlings.
You are in Wrathscale Lair on Bloodmyst Isle, a haunt of Wrathscale naga. Lord Xiz is among the hostile creatures here, alongside shorestalkers and screamers.

You are in the Ruins of Loreth'Aran on Bloodmyst Isle, where Wrathscale sorceresses and marauders roam. Harbinger Mikolaas's survey team was killed here, and the naga took its survey data, which may still be in their hands.
You are in Nazzivian on Bloodmyst Isle, where Nazzivus rogues, felsworn, summoners and satyrs roam. Corrupted treants and grizzled brown bears are found here too.
You are in Axxarien, the satyr stronghold on Bloodmyst Isle. Axxarien shadowstalkers, tricksters and hellcallers are common here, and Zevrax is among the hostile creatures.
You are in Blacksilt Shore, a stretch of Bloodmyst Isle where Blacksilt murlocs, including foragers, scouts and tidecallers, are the main danger. Morae at Blood Watch studies their organization.
You are in The Foul Pool on Bloodmyst Isle, where fouled water spirits changed by crystal energy are the main danger. Hand of Argus defenders from Vindicator's Rest contend with them.

You are in The Hidden Reef, a reef on Bloodmyst Isle. Aqueous, a water elemental, welcomes visitors and can speak with them mind to mind. Aqueous warns that the pollution afflicting the island could spread through the ocean. Blacksilt seers, warriors and shorestrikers lurk in the reef's waters.

You are in Amberweb Pass, a pass on Bloodmyst Isle. Researcher Cornelius, an Alliance researcher, escaped a spider ambush that left his expedition wrapped in cocoons, and he asks for help freeing the others before the brood feeds on them. Myst spinners and leechers and a creature named Zarakh roam the pass.

You are in Wyrmscar Island, a sundered island on Bloodmyst Isle. Prince Toreth, a dragon rider of Loreth'Aran, is bound with his people to the land. He says owlkin have been stealing dragon bones and have unsettled Ysera's brood, and that Razormaw, a dead lieutenant of Deathwing, still haunts the skies. Veridian whelps and broodlings wander the island.

You are in Bristlelimb Enclave, a furbolg camp on Bloodmyst Isle. Bristlelimb warriors and shamans hold Princess Stillpine captive and plan to sacrifice her to their gods. High Chief Bristlelimb keeps the key to her cage.
You are in Ragefeather Ridge, a ridge on Bloodmyst Isle. Infected, irradiated and contaminated wildkin roam the ridge.

You are in Kessel's Crossing, an Alliance camp on Bloodmyst Isle where draenei recruits train for the Hand of Argus. Kessel, an Elekk Lord, tests recruits and sends them on to Exarch Admetius for training. Vorkhan the elekk herder warns that ravagers carried from Outland could upset the island's natural balance. Little Azimi sells fresh fruit and water.

You are in The Bloodcursed Reef, a reef on Bloodmyst Isle. Bloodcursed naga live here, and ghosts of people taken by the bloodcurse wander among them. A dead captain, Edward Hanes, wants their cursed shells destroyed so the souls can rest.

You are in Vindicator's Rest, an Alliance camp on Bloodmyst Isle. Scout Loryi and the wounded Scout Jorli are stranded here on consecrated ground, with ravagers waiting outside. Loryi warns that void critters near the Sun Gate portal could grow into void anomalies. Vindicator Corin readies the defenses for Demolitionist Legoso's mission against the Vector Coil.
You are in Bloodcurse Isle, an island where a shrine to Queen Azshara stands and bloodcursed naga follow their leader Atoph. Captain Hanes has asked travelers to burn the statue there and slay Atoph.

You are in The Bloodwash, an area of Bloodmyst Isle. Clopper Wizbang, an Explorers' League gnome, studies the Blacksilt murlocs from a beached turtle shell so his presence does not disturb them. Blacksilt seers, warriors and shorestrikers, and mutated constrictors, are hostile here.
You are in Veridian Point, an area of Bloodmyst Isle. Agitated spirits of the green dragonflight, whelps and broodlings, linger here alongside bloodcursed naga.
You are in Middenvale, an area of Bloodmyst Isle. Grizzled brown bears and corrupted treants are hostile here.
You are in The Lost Fold, a part of Bloodmyst Isle. Bloodmyst hatchlings and brown bears roam here. Blue Flutterers, small neutral creatures, are seen here too.
You are in Mystwood, a part of Bloodmyst Isle. Grizzled brown bears and corrupted treants roam here. A Thistle Lasher, a plant creature, is found here as well.
